rust_summary: mod-block entity contacts (`native_block_step_on`, `native_block_entity_inside`, `native_block_fall_on`), including mutable landing damage.
doc_summary: mod-block entity contacts: `native_block_step_on`, `native_block_entity_inside` and `native_block_fall_on`. Each receives the server dimension, entity id/type, block state and position. The landing hook also receives fall distance and mutable calculated damage; zero prevents fall hurt and its generic fall sounds. Creative and fall-immune entities notify with zero and retain immunity. Invalid non-finite damage changes are ignored; negative damage is clamped to zero. Hooks run synchronously without `self`, like `native_living_incoming_damage`. Bundles need "hooks": @API:block_contacts@.
